purpose: Verify three-equation Euler/Rusanov interface fluxes when adjacent finite-volume cells use different teacher-source-backed H2/C2H4 algebraic compositions, before adding variable-composition SSP-RK3 time advancement.
implemented: cell-wise physical Euler flux using local Y_i
single-interface Rusanov flux with independent left/right thermochemical recovery
transmissive compatibility boundary fluxes copying both state and composition
quasi-one-dimensional geometric pressure source using cell-wise composition
scientific_boundaries: The numerical state remains only [rho, rho*u, rho*E]; no species transport PDE is introduced.
Composition is an externally/algebraically prescribed cell field during this compatibility step.
The Rusanov dissipative jump acts on the three conservative flow variables only. No claim is made that this is a conservative species-mixing discretization.
No teacher reaction-energy Qdot source is added; composition-dependent absolute species energy remains the chemical-energy representation.
Transmissive faces are verification boundaries, not the final teacher inlet/outlet adapter.
Steger-Warming with variable composition remains a later numerical-method task; Rusanov is retained first as the unambiguous compatibility flux.
next_step: Add a narrow prescribed-composition SSP-RK3/CFL compatibility march and prove uniform-composition reduction and conservation before coupling the teacher eta/phi field update and wall/fuel source terms.
